measure_library.name: Best FY
measure_library.dax:
VAR FYSales = 
    SUMMARIZE(
        '{fact_table}',
        '{date_table}'[FiscalYear],
        "Total '{fact_table}'", SUMX('{fact_table}', '{fact_table}'[QuantitySold] * '{fact_table}'[Price])
    )
VAR TopFY = 
    TOPN(
        1,
        FYSales,
        [Total '{fact_table}'],
        DESC
    )
RETURN
    MAXX(TopFY, '{date_table}'[FiscalYear])
measure_library.original_dax:
VAR FYSales = 
    SUMMARIZE(
        Sales,
        'Date'[FiscalYear],
        "Total Sales", SUMX(Sales, Sales[QuantitySold] * Sales[Price])
    )
VAR TopFY = 
    TOPN(
        1,
        FYSales,
        [Total Sales],
        DESC
    )
RETURN
    MAXX(TopFY, 'Date'[FiscalYear])

measure_library.name: Best Selling Product
measure_library.dax:
VAR TopProduct = 
    TOPN(
        1,
        SUMMARIZE(
            '{fact_table}', 'Product'[ProductName],
            "Total '{fact_table}'", SUM('{fact_table}'[QuantitySold])
        ),
        [Total '{fact_table}'],
        DESC
    )
RETURN
    MAXX(TopProduct, 'Product'[ProductName])
measure_library.original_dax:
VAR TopProduct = 
    TOPN(
        1,
        SUMMARIZE(
            Sales, 'Product'[ProductName],
            "Total Sales", SUM(Sales[QuantitySold])
        ),
        [Total Sales],
        DESC
    )
RETURN
    MAXX(TopProduct, 'Product'[ProductName])

measure_library.name: SalesGrowth
measure_library.dax:
VAR CurrMonthSales = [Total '{fact_table}']
VAR PrevMonthSales = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total '{fact_table}'],
        DATEADD('{date_table}'['{date_table}'], -1, MONTH)
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CurrMonthSales - PrevMonthSales, PrevMonthSales, 0)
measure_library.original_dax:
VAR CurrMonthSales = [Total Sales]
VAR PrevMonthSales = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, MONTH)
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CurrMonthSales - PrevMonthSales, PrevMonthSales, 0)
